For this mission, a Space Launch System (SLS) rocket will send an Orion spacecraft carrying the four astronaut crew members to lunar orbit. The mission depends on a prior support flight to place a lunar lander—either SpaceX's Starship HLS or Blue Origin's Blue Moon—into lunar orbit before the crew launch.
gold_answer: The placement of a lunar lander into lunar orbit before the crew launch

question: Prior to 2018, what was the typical year of the Venice Biennale of Architecture?
context: The Venice Biennale of Architecture (Italian: Mostra di Architettura di Venezia) is an international exhibition showcasing architectural works from around the world, held in Venice, Italy, every other year. Originally held in even-numbered years until 2018, the event was postponed in 2020 due to the COVID-19 pandemic and rescheduled for 2021, shifting the calendar to odd-numbered years. It forms the architecture section of the broader Venice Biennale and was officially established in 1980, although architecture had been included in the Venice Art Biennale since 1968.
gold_answer: Even-numbered years

question: On what date was the 2025 Nobel Peace Prize announced by the Norwegian Nobel Committee?
